Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management(VP - AI Strategic Transformation).
Business:CTO Innov & Digital Part
Job ID: 63971
Principal Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities:
Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Own the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme – building and maintaining the plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID log and financials, and ensuring the workstream delivers against the commitments made into the wider programme.
Programme governance and reporting: Run the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream – preparing status reporting, steering and programme board submissions, and ensuring a single, accurate and timely view of progress, risk and value is available to the Group AI programme and to IDP leadership.
Cross-workstream integration: Act as IDP's interface into the Group AI programme, managing dependencies with other workstreams, escalating blockers, and ensuring partnership commitments, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the overall programme view.
Strategy development and execution: Support the Director of IDP in shaping and refreshing the function's strategy – conducting analysis, developing options and recommendations, translating agreed direction into objectives, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, and tracking delivery against them.
Operating rhythm and governance: Run the operating rhythm for the Director of IDP and the leadership team – setting agendas, preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and driving follow-through to closure.
Team effectiveness and organisational health: Support the Director of IDP on organisational and team matters, including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability planning and cultural initiatives that sustain a high-performing global team.
Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.
Leadership & Teamwork
Lead the Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream through matrix leadership of contributors across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, without direct line authority.
Bring cohesion to the IDP China leadership team – connecting agendas, surfacing tensions early, and holding colleagues to the commitments they have made
Requirements
Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.
Stakeholder engagement: Strong grasp of engaging with diverse stakeholders, covering business, technology and external partnerships, to align innovation efforts with bank priorities.
AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services – sufficient to engage credibly with technical colleagues and strategic partners, and to translate technical progress into business terms.
Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are structured, governed and commercially realised within a large, regulated organisation.
Strategic: Proven track record in translating strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes.
/WX/LP
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Description
Job Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end account documentation for Payments and Markets clients, including client onboarding, account maintenance, account closure.
Validate the document based on Firm's guidelines, such as signature verification and client call back.
Review existing document available that can be leveraged to support the validation, including reference to public available information platform to confirm the authorized signers where applicable.
Index document into approved Firm's repositories according to SOP to ensure the accuracy of metadata tagging.
Monitor the incoming requests and queries from various stakeholders.
Identify and communicate business partner requirements and escalate outstanding issues in a timely manner.
Drive the implementation and execution of global DDS mandates and objectives.
Record and track the status of each case including but not limited to special approval according to approval matrix, reporting and escalating to service recipient and other internal stakeholders.
Prepare MIS report as required by consolidating various data source according to pre-defined report logic.
General understanding of and execute internal procedural guidelines, policies (as well as related internal procedures and standards) in accordance with local and global principles.
Ensure Standard Operating Procedures are updated reflecting the latest process.
Design, monitor, review and develop efficient client documents handling process, systems, and workflow by working closely with multiple functions and teams for thorough identification of responsibilities.
Provide operational support to supply audit / compliance / regulator with query handling, analysis as required.
Previous experiences related to or a deep understanding of local regulations/legal guideline on corporate client documentation requirement would be an advantage.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree or above
Minimum 2 years' working experience in back-office operations or account/cash operations of bank/financial industry
Strong operational knowledge, with experience in handling corporate account/Payments product is preferred
Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to work under pressure and high volume environment within tight deadlines and cut-off
Fluent in speaking, reading & writing skills in both English & Chinese Mandarin
Must be a self-starter with the motivation, demonstration of initiative, and ownership mentality to think outside of the box as necessary
Ability to multi-task, identify priorities, work independently and excellent execution mentality
Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc.). Data-driven professional with expertise in data analytics tools or automation skills would be a plus (Alteryx, Tableau, VBA etc.)
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. DevOps / ADO

主动推广指定的个人银行产品和服务及开发新客户。

Engage NTB Affluent clients via leads sourced from varies channels;
A well thought-through, creative approach to satisfy customers, improve competitive advantage and improve performance;
Actively cross-sell the bank other products / services and ensure annual financial budget is met;

Based on a clear division of roles (and no duplication of effort) within MD;

Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
主要工作职责/挑战：
参与促销活动，完成或超额完成指定的销售目标；
跟进销售机会，开发新客户；
以周全、创新的方法使客户满意，提升竞争优势及业绩表现；
主动销售银行其它产品和服务，确保达到年度销售业绩指标；

编写和维护有关销售活动的准确报告；
负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity.

Actively learning from experimentation, success, and failures. Applying lessons learned to new problems.

1 year working experience or above in financial or mortgage / real estate Industry is preferred.

有相关银行行业销售经验者优先

良好的信用评价与营销技能，对金融市场有敏锐触角。

优良的个性品质，勇于销售及解决业务过程中的问题。

Job Summary
The role exists to ensure the efficient, controlled and client-focused execution of operational activities that support Wealth Management products, services and client transactions. The role is accountable for delivering operational excellence across core processes while maintaining strong risk and control standards, service quality and regulatory compliance.
Working closely with Front Office teams, Product partners, Risk and Compliance functions, the role oversees operational processes that enable the end-to-end client lifecycle, including onboarding, transaction processing, account maintenance, investment servicing and operational issue resolution. The role ensures service commitments are met while managing operational risks and supporting business growth objectives.
Through effective governance, process optimisation and stakeholder engagement, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience, regulatory compliance and the scalability of Wealth Management operations.

Client & Transaction Operations
Manage Wealth Management operational processes to ensure accurate, timely and controlled execution of client transactions and servicing activities.
Oversee transaction processing, account maintenance and operational support activities to meet agreed service levels and client expectations.
Resolve operational exceptions, enquiries and escalations to minimise client impact and maintain service quality.
Monitor operational performance and capacity to ensure sustainable support for business growth and changing client needs.
Client Lifecycle & Service Delivery
Lead operational activities across client onboarding, account opening, maintenance and closure processes to support a seamless client experience.
Ensure client records, documentation and account information remain accurate, complete and compliant with regulatory requirements.
Coordinate with Front Office, Compliance and Risk teams to facilitate timely completion of client lifecycle activities.
Identify and address service gaps to improve operational efficiency and client outcomes.
Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance
Maintain effective controls across Wealth Management operations to mitigate operational, regulatory and conduct risks.
Ensure operational activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements and established control standards.
Investigate operational incidents, root causes and control weaknesses, implementing corrective actions where required.
Support audits, reviews and regulatory examinations through accurate documentation, reporting and remediation tracking.
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Analyse operational performance data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and efficiency improvements.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, reduce risk and improve service delivery outcomes.
Establish and monitor key operational metrics, service indicators and management information to support decision-making.
Drive adoption of standardised processes and best practices across Wealth Management Operations.

Partner with Wealth Management, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams to support effective operational delivery.
Provide operational insights and recommendations that inform service improvements, risk mitigation and business decisions.
Facilitate governance forums, operational reviews and stakeholder discussions to drive accountability and action.
Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication, issue resolution and proactive engagement.

Support implementation of new products, regulatory changes and strategic initiatives by assessing operational impacts and readiness requirements.
Coordinate testing, process updates and operational transition activities to ensure successful implementation.
Embed new controls, procedures and operating models to maintain operational effectiveness.
Monitor post-implementation outcomes and address operational issues arising from change initiatives.

Driving operational excellence through process improvement, data-driven insights and scalable solutions that enhance client experience, service quality and risk management.
Solving complex operational challenges by balancing client needs, regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations while maintaining strong controls and service standards.
Leading high-performing teams and change initiatives that build capability, strengthen operational resilience and support sustainable business growth.

Must-have Skills
Investment Management
Account Reconciliation
Custodial Services
Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
Mutual Funds
Product Management
Settlement Management
Tax Management
Financial Services
Stakeholder Engagement
Continuous Improvement
Talent Development

Key Experiences
Experience managing Wealth Management, Private Banking, Investment Operations or related financial services operations.
Experience overseeing client lifecycle, transaction processing, account servicing or investment operations activities.
Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements, productivity enhancements or control strengthening initiatives.
Experience managing operational risk, audit findings, regulatory requirements and remediation activities.
Experience working with Front Office, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
Proven ability to manage operational performance, service levels, governance forums and stakeholder expectations.
Experience leading teams, developing talent and driving a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

Ensures alignment, maintenance and updating of relevant systems as required to achieve required operational and regulatory outcomes

Assures Individual CDD risk management through testing of the related CSTs ensures compilation, review and distribution of M.I, reports and escalates exceptions and tracks to closure

Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
